name: Daisy!
texts: I enter ready. Reduce my cost by :rb_energy_1: for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro. When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun] an enemy unit here.
manual: Reduce my cost by :rb_energy_1: for each of the following tags among your units — Bird, Cat, Dog, and Poro.
When I attack while your units have all 4 tags, [Stun] an enemy unit here.
